tokens.name: sand-50
tokens.usage: Page background everywhere. The site is light-only.

tokens.name: sand-100
tokens.usage: Map ground inside RouteWordMap, quiet section bands, the mobile overlay fade.

tokens.name: sand-200
tokens.usage: Hairline borders on cards and dividers between list rows.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Card surface (ServiceCard, LocationCard, OverlayCard) sitting on sand-50.

tokens.name: concrete-300
tokens.usage: Abstract map streets. Never used for text.

tokens.name: concrete-400
tokens.usage: Outline and X of the small plan-style buildings on the map. Decorative only.

tokens.name: concrete-500
tokens.usage: Completed routes and completed destination markers, drawn at route-completed-opacity. Decorative only, never text (3.3:1 on sand-50).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Charcoal text: headings and body on sand-50, sand-100 and paper (13.9:1). Also the label on route-orange buttons (5.0:1) and the focus ring.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, descriptions, meta rows on sand-50, sand-100 and paper (6.0:1 or better).

tokens.name: route-orange
tokens.usage: THE accent: the active GPS route, the origin and current destination marker, primary button fill. One per screen region. As a 4px line on sand it is 2.8:1, so it never carries text and never stands alone as the only signal.

tokens.name: route-orange-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the primary button — a lighter step, so the ink label gains contrast (5.8:1).

tokens.name: ink-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the dark button; sand-50 label on it.

tokens.name: route-orange-text
tokens.usage: Orange when it must be read: inline links, eyebrows, the English accent phrase on sand-50 or paper (5.1:1).

tokens.name: route-orange-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind the route Tag and hover state of secondary buttons. Text on it stays ink (12.5:1).

tokens.name: olive
tokens.usage: Very light secondary accent for nature/mountain context: the nature Tag and park blocks on the map. Readable as text on sand-50 (6.3:1); use rarely.

tokens.name: olive-soft
tokens.usage: Park blocks on the abstract map and the nature Tag background. Ink on it is 12.7:1.

tokens.name: park
tokens.usage: Park blocks on the abstract map — saturated enough to read as green space at a glance. No street crosses a park.

tokens.name: park-edge
tokens.usage: 1px edge of park blocks.

tokens.name: track-red
tokens.usage: Only inside the stadium-track motif from the brand asset (Motifs/track-mark.png). Not a UI colour.

tokens.name: track-green
tokens.usage: Only the infield of the stadium-track motif. Not a UI colour.

styles.name: fa-display
styles.sample: از اولین قدم، مسیرت رو بساز.
styles.usage: Hero and final-CTA headline only. 36px/52px on mobile.

styles.name: fa-body
styles.sample: اینجا فقط نمی‌دوی؛ مسیرت رو می‌سازی.
styles.usage: All Persian paragraphs. Keep blocks to 2–3 sentences.

styles.name: fa-small
styles.usage: Meta rows (level, time, audience), button labels.

styles.name: en-display
styles.usage: The English support line under a Persian headline, set in ink or route-orange-text. Never longer than one short phrase.

styles.name: en-phrase
styles.usage: Short English phrases inside Persian sections.

styles.name: en-eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows above titles and Tag labels, in route-orange-text or ink-muted.

styles.name: en-label
styles.usage: English button labels and data such as Beginner / Intermediate.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between eyebrow and title, between Tags.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between meta rows in a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile side gutter; padding inside Tags and small buttons.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop side gutter; overlay panel padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between a section title and its content.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm between non-pinned sections (64px on mobile).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, inputs, small badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and the overlay panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons — a pill echoes the stadium-track shape of the logo.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: The one shadow: cards and the desktop overlay panel. Barely there; borders do the separating.

tokens.name: shadow-map
tokens.usage: Soft vignette on the abstract map so its edges fade.

route.note: The GPS line. Geometry values used by RouteWordMap, RouteDivider and RouteMarker.

tokens.name: route-width
tokens.usage: Route stroke on desktop (≥ 768px).

tokens.name: route-width-mobile
tokens.usage: Route stroke below 768px.

tokens.name: route-completed-opacity
tokens.usage: Opacity of completed words and markers — DEFAULT_COMPLETED_OPACITY in the RouteWordMap spec.

tokens.name: street-width
tokens.usage: Abstract map street stroke in concrete-300.

tokens.name: marker-size
tokens.usage: Diameter of origin and destination markers.
